about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-53: a stewardship and governance document (GOVERNANCE.md) and a stable, machine-readable check-ID registry (docs/check-ids.json) that CI holds to the published catalogue, so other projects can cite a check id and rely on it not changing meaning. XC-00 covers licence, notice, CODEOWNERS and SECURITY but no governance document, and a suite that wants to be the one everyone runs has to say who decides, how a check gets in, how ids stay stable and how it stays vendor-neutral. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file; it becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope and pushed fails on the v1.6.0 tree. The stewardship section states the owner's own position on a future neutral home; this task does not contact anyone.

tasks.title: Governance and stewardship, and check ids that never change meaning
tasks.description: GOVERNANCE.md states: the maintainers and how someone becomes one; how decisions are made (proposals in issues and Discussions, binding work as Proofline tasks signed only by the owner key); the check admission bar (linking docs/ROADMAP.md 'How I decide what goes in'); the check-id policy (an id is never reused or removed, a change of meaning gets a new id, deprecations are listed in CHANGELOG and kept in the registry); neutrality (no implementation is treated differently, there is no paid tier, results are never sold, the same disclosure rules apply to everyone); conflicts of interest (the licensor and his company, stated plainly); disclosure (linking SECURITY.md); and stewardship (what would move the project to a neutral home and on what terms). tools/check_ids.py writes docs/check-ids.json from the catalogue (id, profile, one-line property, spec basis, first release, status) and --check fails when the registry is stale, an id present at the last release tag is missing, or an id's property text changed without a deprecation entry.

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import sys;s=open('GOVERNANCE.md').read();h=['## Maintainers','## Decisions','## Adding or changing a check','## Check ids','## Neutrality','## Conflicts of interest','## Disclosure','## Stewardship'];m=[x for x in h if x not in s];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

criteria.statement: The check-id registry matches the catalogue, and no id published at v1.6.0 is missing or has changed meaning without a deprecation entry
A removed id, a reused id and a silently changed property are each detected
CI runs the check-id gate on every push
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
GOVERNANCE.md states the owner's own position only. Do not name, quote or commit to any third party, and do not contact anyone.
